title: Orange Beetle vs Angel
description: A surreal scene shows a humanoid insect figure wearing a yellow patterned coat and a large backpack covered in oranges and flowers, holding a bloody revolver in one hand and a dripping organ in the other. In the background, a winged angelic figure resembling Jesus stands with open arms inside a glowing circular stone portal decorated with skulls and columns, set against a dark swirling sky with smoke and ghosts.
